description: This source file defines the Cgroup struct and functions to parse and retrieve cgroup information for processes from /proc/[pid]/cgroup in Linux systems, supporting both cgroups v1 and v2.

classes.name: Cgroup
classes.description: Models a line from /proc/[pid]/cgroup, representing a process's placement within a control hierarchy.

methods.name: parseCgroupString
methods.description: Parses a single line from /proc/[pid]/cgroup into a Cgroup struct.

methods.name: parseCgroups
methods.description: Parses the entire content of /proc/[pid]/cgroup into a slice of Cgroup structs.

methods.name: Cgroups
methods.description: Method of Proc struct that reads and returns the cgroup hierarchy information for a process.
